leadText:
Pokémon the First Movie: Original Motion Picture Score is the English score to the first Pokémon movie, Mewtwo Strikes Back. It was released in the United States in 2000 by . The music was reused in the English dub of Mewtwo Returns. Manny Corallo, Deniz Hughes, John Lissauer, John Loeffler, Kenneth Lampl and Ralph Schuckett are credited as composers.

The album is available on Spotify. It was re-released by Laced Records on August 15, 2025 and subsequently re-titled Pokémon: The First Movie.

The music was reused in the English dub of Mewtwo Returns. Manny Corallo, Deniz Hughes, John Lissauer, John Loeffler, Kenneth Lampl and Ralph Schuckett are credited as composers.

The album is available on Spotify. It was re-released by Laced Records on August 15, 2025 and subsequently re-titled Pokémon: The First Movie.

==Tracklist==
 

==Trivia==
On the original CD track listing, the song "All Good Things Must End" was misspelled "All Good Things Must Ends". This was corrected in the album's re-release on the American iTunes Store.
The track "Adventure in Paradise" contains music that was replaced in the movie by "Catch Me if You Can".
Most of the tracks used here are reused in Mewtwo Returns, an animated series special that serves as a sequel to the first movie.
European releases of the CD listed the Pokémon Theme as a bonus track on the CD. , the theme for the show's second season, is featured rather than the correct theme music.
